title: Autonomous resilient harness, Tasks workbench and chat stability
request:
Improve the harness for continual self-improvement, autonomous operation, fallback options when usage runs out, and better guardrails; redesign the Tasks page to be more presentable and interactive; and investigate and fix intermittent chat glitches.

The agreed plan: bh plan show p-20261121-0hfk

steps.title: Task 1 — Chat stability (engine): Make `replies/<key>.jsonl` the single atomic/append-only chat event log (`at`, `kind`, `id`, `space`, plus `kind: "asked"` so `bh ask` clears waits without a false 8 s silent note), wire `bh reply` into the same log, sanitize OSC/DCS escape sequences from harness stdout, guard the `on()` stdout handler against mid-turn throws, and update reply/log tests (`test/agents-reply.test.mjs`, `test/empty-reply.test.mjs`, `test/feed-items.test.mjs`).

report.summary: Fixed stripUnsafeEscapes fixed-point OSC/DCS + C1 stripping, applied it to 3 say() error paths, added 4 bypass regression assertions; chat-engine tests + bh check PASS

steps.title: Task 1 — Chat stability (UI & gate): Fix all 9 verified chat UI glitches (`chat.js` `this.page` method shadowing, monotonic `feed.js` IDs past 300 entries, scroll-anchor preservation when `back > 0`, worker-status change notifications, arrival/hover/composer-collapse races, queued cross-page `sendText` that never routes into open question cards, `adopt()` in `poll()`, shared `OpenQuestions` dismissals, and quiet-harness key cleanup) with pure-module regression tests; pass QA gate, commit, push to `origin/main`, and run `node install.mjs`.

Task 2 — Failure classification & fallback engine: Add `mods/bot-herdr/engine/lib/failures.mjs` classifying permanent quota exhaustion (with parsed reset time), transient 429, auth, timeout, and crash across Claude Code (including headless exit-0 JSON `result`), Codex (`turn.failed`), OpenCode (ACP `_meta["opencode/retry"]` + non-ACP 429), Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Antigravity, and pi; build ordered fallback chains (same-CLI next model first preserving the live session, then fallback harness continuing from the dirty worktree with `git diff --stat` + handoff digest, then hold until reset), shared `DATA/cooldowns.json`, additive per-harness `DATA/sessions/`, `state.seen` preservation on failed turns, permission/allowlist non-escalation guards, and `roster.clean` / `bh team save` persistence.

Task 2 — Engine guardrails & Resilience UI (gate): Enforce hard engine guardrails — block `.bot-herdr/scripts/` from shadowing built-in `bh check` scripts, enforce `personOnly` and protected-path checks, add runtime circuit breakers (per-task spend/turn/retry ceilings, 3× identical-failure thrash breaker, max QA/spawn/recursion caps), require git branch/worktree isolation in autonomous mode, and verify merged trees before discarding child branches; build the Resilience tab in Settings (fallback chains, provider cooldown health with `Retry now`/`Reset all`, guardrail budgets) plus the slim live status strip above the composer and on Tasks (with `Pause`/`Reset`) backed by JSON `bh` commands; pass fake-harness/worktree/UI tests, QA gate, commit, push, and `node install.mjs`.

Task 3 — Tasks engine contracts & interactive workbench (gate): Add lightweight Tasks engine contracts (`bh task list --summary`, `bh task show <id> --json` for the open task's live board/step events/checks/gates, explicit allowed actions, `--if-updated` optimistic concurrency guard, live step-level running/fallback status) and rebuild `mods/bot-herdr/work.js`, `steps.js`, and `signals.js` in the Split list with detail tabs layout (search + status filter chips, `+ New task`, compact progress bars replacing wide pips, `Steps` · `Board` · `Comments` · `Full plan` detail tabs, expandable interactive step cards with events/checks/reports/`Open terminal`/step actions, QA gate badge, single-scroll desktop & narrow layout, foldable `taskComposer`, race-free refresh queuing); pass pure-module tests, gpui-kit `tsc`, QA gate, commit, push, and `node install.mjs`.

Task 4 — Eval-gated continual self-improvement & auto-install (gate): Build `mods/bot-herdr/engine/lib/improve.mjs` and `bh improve` to mine post-task telemetry (`checks.jsonl`, `gates`, `board.jsonl`, `usage.jsonl`, refused commands, idle timeouts), fold/archive knowledge below the 20k/8k cap, apply eval-gated tweaks across project learning, role prompts, and mod engine/UI code on an isolated branch (permanently blocking edits that weaken or shadow `personOnly`, access checks, or built-in `bh check` scripts), run `npm test`, `bh check`, gpui-kit `tsc`, and guardrail invariants before merging and running `node install.mjs`, record before/after experiment verdicts, and perform validated automatic rollback (never keep-after-rejection) if checks fail or next-window metrics regress; pass rollback/invariant tests, QA gate, commit, push, and `node install.mjs`.

focusAreas: security boundaries: the wrong user, no user and an expired session are refused, and no secret leaks
concurrency: races, ordering, double runs, and a lock or claim that is never released
state transitions and recovery: no illegal or stuck state, and a crash or failed step recovers
isolation: work stays inside its branch, worktree and permission boundaries
data integrity: what is saved reads back the same, a migration runs on real data, and a failure halfway loses or corrupts nothing
